title: 03 3.3V BUCK-BOOST POWER REGULATOR
purpose: TPS63802DLAR high-efficiency (up to 95%) 2A buck-boost converter delivering tightly regulated 3.3V to the ESP32-S3 MCU, sensors, audio, and display across full LiPo discharge (2.7V to 4.2V) and USB power (5V). Configured with 470nH power inductor, 10uF input capacitor, and 2x10uF output capacitors for ultra-low transient ripple.

parts.role: 10k pull-up resistor on PG (Power Good) to 3V3 rail
10uF ceramic input decoupling capacitor on VIN
10uF second ceramic output capacitor for low ESR/ripple

qa.formula: L = 0.47 uH recommended for 2.5 MHz switching frequency (TPS63802 Datasheet Section 9.2.2.1)
qa.result: L1 = 0.47 uH (XFL4015-471MEC, Isat = 4.4A, DCR = 16 mOhm). Well exceeds peak inductor current (I_peak ~ 2.2A under full 1A output at 2.8V input).
qa.source: Texas Instruments TPS63802 Datasheet SLVSEU9B Section 9.2.2.1

qa.formula: C_out_min = 20 uF nominal effective capacitance to maintain delta_Vout <= 30 mV during 500 mA load transients
qa.result: C7 + C8 = 2x 10 uF 0603 16V X5R + C9 0.1 uF = 20.1 uF nominal. Derated effective capacitance at 3.3V is ~14.2 uF, providing robust loop stability and <25 mV output ripple.
qa.source: Texas Instruments TPS63802 Datasheet SLVSEU9B Section 9.2.2.2

qa.formula: C_in >= 10 uF to buffer high switching frequency ripple currents
qa.result: C6 = 10 uF 0603 placed adjacent to VIN pin 10 and GND pin 8 minimizes parasitic loop inductance.
qa.source: Texas Instruments TPS63802 Datasheet SLVSEU9B Section 9.2.2.3
